topic: Rendered public cart/checkout shipping quotes for the tracked Crema e Gusto listings
method: Interactive headless Google Chrome 154 + ChromeDriver 154 through scripts/browser-research.mjs (npm run research:browser). One anonymous cart per vendor was created by adding the tracked product; the public checkout shipping estimator was read without submitting an order, logging in, creating an account or entering any street address. Locality/postcode fields were filled only for Pucks (Tel Aviv / 6100000 and Eilat / 8800000). Cart/session identifiers, cookies and tokens are deliberately not recorded.
toolingLimitation: The available file-read tool rejects PNG input ('reading images is not supported'), so the saved screenshots could not be visually inspected by the model. All quotes below are therefore backed by the rendered visible text / DOM excerpts captured through the same live session; screenshots are kept as artifacts for a human reviewer. No claim of image-based visual review is made for this batch.

sourceNotes: Coffee4U product page title tag currently reads 'Lavazza Qualita Oro Beans 1 kg' while the rendered H1/body is 'Lavazza Crema e gusto 250 gr טחון' at 38 ILS; the mismatch is a stale page title on the vendor side and did not change the cart item.

CoffeeMan product pages publish courier 25.00 ILS for the single and 4-pack, while the anonymous checkout quoted 20.00 ILS for the 8-pack (2 kg) cart. Both are recorded as observed; the difference is not explained by any public page and is not averaged or guessed.

Screenshots saved next to this file: pucks-checkout-2packs.png, pucks-checkout-4packs.png, coffeeman-checkout-8pack.png, coffee4u-checkout-courier.png. They could not be machine-inspected (see toolingLimitation).
No order was submitted, no payment or login step was started, no street address or personal detail was entered, and no bot challenge or access control was bypassed.
